note: WAEC Commerce Paper 1 round 1 (Round 16e): the WASSCE syllabus with FRESH angles - Nigerian agencies (CBN, NDIC, SON, NAFDAC, ARCON, Nigerian Exchange), document and payment scenarios (Kano-to-Aba home trade, POS stalls, dishonoured cheques, crossed cheques), insurance principles restated as stories, and a new e-commerce topic (payment gateways, OTP security, drop-shipping, shrinkflation) - because the near-dup scan checks every item against the JAMB, WAEC and NECO banks INCLUDING the large JAMB Commerce banks (003, 030-031) and the 74-item NECO Commerce bank. Topics: home and foreign trade, aids to trade, business units, trade documents and payments, banking and the stock exchange, insurance, consumer protection, e-commerce.
